title: Area and Circumference of Circles Flashcards

cards.front: What is the mathematical name for a straight line from the centre to the edge of a circle?

options.explanation: The radius is a straight line segment from the centre of a circle to any point on its circumference.
The diameter passes through the centre and joins two points on the circumference. A line from the centre to one point on the circumference is the radius.
A chord joins two points on the circumference and does not have to pass through the centre. The required line from the centre to the edge is the radius.
A tangent is a line that touches a circle at exactly one point. The straight line from the centre to the edge is called the radius.
